name: skillsmith
description: Skillsmith: an AI production line for founders. Idea in, verified product out.

scripts.check:build: npm run build && git diff --exit-code -- plugins/skillsmith/engine
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test .build/test/*.test.js
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include='.build/src/**' --test-coverage-lines=85 --test-coverage-functions=85 .build/test/*.test.js
scripts.validate: claude plugin validate . --strict && claude plugin validate ./plugins/skillsmith --strict
